_comment: Tier to model, per host. Edit to match your plans and prices. Jev never sees this file; code applies it.

opencode._comment: Cloud models on the opencode Go plan, run through opencode. Default DeepSeek v4.1 Flash; on failure the runner retries once on MiniMax M3. Kimi dropped: same output, ~37x the cost. High-stakes work never goes here.

budget_boxes._comment: Time budgets in minutes the launcher picks from, by task size, not by tier. Over the box: stop and re-split, never extend. See the rjv-subagents skill.

thresholds._comment: Untuned starting points. Tune from the decision log (scripts/jev-log-review.sh).
